description: This program is a store that allows you to add instruments into a cart, view the cart, and delete items from the cart.
techniques: Techniques such as CRUD (that is Create, Read, Update, and Delete) were the backbone of this project. You needed to be able to all of these to your cart, or else, it wouldn't be complete. If you can't delete or update then there's no room for mistakes. If you can't create than there is no purpose to the program. And if you can't read then you'd just have to try and remember what you bought.
